title: Crash when GDScript scripts are reloaded during initial import in v4.4.1
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.4.1
- Not reproducible in v4.3.0

### System information

Linux (Ubuntu 24.04) - Forward+ - Vulkan

### Issue description

The issue was very similar to #108946.

An example crash log would be like
```
GDScript: Reloading: res://addons/resources_spreadsheet_view/import_export/import_export_enum_format.gd
GDScript: Reloading: res://addons/resources_spreadsheet_view/import_export/property_list_item.gd
GDScript: Reloading: res://addons/resources_spreadsheet_view/import_export/formats_export/export_csv.gd
GDScript: Reloading: res://addons/resources_spreadsheet_view/import_export/import_export_dialog.gd
GDScript: Reloading: res://addons/resources_spreadsheet_view/text_editing_utils.gd
GDScript: Reloading: res://addons/resources_spreadsheet_view/main_screen/selection_manager.gd
GDScript: Reloading: res://addons/resources_spreadsheet_view/main_screen/input_handler.gd
GDScript: Reloading: res://addons/resources_spreadsheet_view/typed_editors/dock_dict.gd
GDScript: Reloading: res://addons/resources_spreadsheet_view/typed_editors/dock_texture.gd
GDScript: Reloading: res://addons/resources_spreadsheet_view/typed_editors/dock_number.gd
GDScript: Reloading: res://addons/resources_spreadsheet_view/typed_editors/dock_color.gd
================================================================
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.mono.official (49a5bc7b616bd04689a2c89e89bda41f50241464)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug to the project developer.
/usr/bin/bash: line 754:   133 Segmentation fault      (core dumped) godot --headless --export-$BUILD_CONFIGURATION $TARGET --verbose project.godot
```


### Steps to reproduce

Even the #108946 shows that the issue might not be reproducible in v4.4.1, we've encountered for about 1/4 chances of crashing in the phase of reloading GDScript scripts during exporting.
